projects.title: Heimdall - Telemetry Character Device Driver
projects.shortDescription: Linux character-device driver in C for Android, with swappable sensor sources behind a versioned seam and a headless QEMU test harness.
projects.fullDescription: • Linux character-device driver in C exposing /dev/telemetry0, streaming samples to userspace over open, read, ioctl and copy_to_user. • Versioned source_ops seam lets virtual and real sensors swap beneath the syscall layer; built on cdev, sysfs, a mutex and an IRQ-safe spinlock. • Cross-compiled for arm64 and ran on an Android GKI emulator with a C NDK client on bionic, verifying vermagic before load. • Headless QEMU harness automates the insmod/rmmod loop, with deliberate oops and leak modules for reading kernel taint output.

projects.title: Home Lab Kubernetes Cluster
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise-grade Kubernetes infrastructure with 9 HP Spectre SFF PC nodes, Calico CNI, and GitLab CI/CD.
projects.fullDescription:
• 9-node Kubernetes cluster on HP SFF PCs running Ubuntu, with Calico for network segmentation.
• High-availability control plane with load balancing and scheduling tuned for even workload spread.
• Images built with Packer; zero-downtime deploys through a GitLab CI/CD pipeline.
• Istio service mesh, Prometheus and Grafana dashboards and alerts, managed through Lens.

projects.title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
projects.shortDescription: Architected and benchmarked ML models for fraud detection, improving precision and reducing false positives.
projects.fullDescription:
• Benchmarked four ML models for fraud detection across six evaluation metrics.
• Feature selection approach raised precision by 23% and cut false positives by about 30%.
• Handled heavy class imbalance with resampling and custom loss functions.
• First-author paper in IRJMETS, Vol. 4, 2022.
projects.journal: International Research Journal of Modernization in Engineering Technology and Science (IRJMETS)
projects.citation: Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Credit Card Fraud Detection - Vol 4, 2022
projects.citationContent: Palaspagar, T. (2022). Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Credit Card Fraud Detection. International Research Journal of Modernization in Engineering Technology and Science, 4.

projects.title: Advanced Stock Price Prediction System
projects.shortDescription: Developed a stock price prediction system using time series regression, deep learning (LSTM), and Streamlit.
projects.fullDescription:
• Stock price forecasting with time-series regression and an LSTM network.
• FBProphet for trend and seasonality forecasts.
• Streamlit app for interactive charts and live predictions.

projects.title: Conway's Game of Life in Go and HTMX
projects.shortDescription: Interactive cellular automaton simulation built with Go backend and HTMX frontend, featuring custom router implementation and real-time grid manipulation.
projects.fullDescription: •Why Go and HTMX? Because a famous Netflix employee once said: [link] • Game of Life on a Go backend with an HTMX frontend, with no JavaScript framework. • Hand-written HTTP router with zero external dependencies. • Pre-allocated grid buffers keep the 50x30 simulation smooth; toggle, step, randomize and clear via HTMX partial updates.

projects.title: Smart Solid Waste Management and Composting System
projects.shortDescription: Engineered an Arduino-based IoT prototype for automated organic waste composting.
projects.fullDescription:
• Arduino and ESP32 prototype for automated waste segregation and composting.
• Sensor-driven control of the composting environment.
• Custom circuit design and power management, with data logging to refine the system.

projects.title: Fuzzy Logic-Based Fingerprint Recognition System
projects.shortDescription: Advanced biometric authentication system using Fuzzy C-Means clustering and statistical features for fingerprint segmentation and enhancement.
projects.fullDescription:
• Fingerprint recognition using Fuzzy C-Means clustering with statistical features (mean, variance, higher-order moments).
• Sliding-window segmentation isolates the print from background noise; outperformed K-means segmentation.
• Full pipeline: segmentation, enhancement, minutiae extraction, orientation estimation, classification and matching.
• Research under Prof. Surekha Janrao.
projects.citation: An Application of Fuzzy Logic to Fingerprint Recognition, 2019
projects.citationContent: Palaspagar, T. (2022). Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Credit Card Fraud Detection. International Research Journal of Modernization in Engineering Technology and Science, 4.

projects.title: Bayesian Networks Inference Engine
projects.shortDescription: Command-line probabilistic inference engine implementing Bayesian Networks with conditional probability calculations and evidence-based reasoning.
projects.fullDescription:
• Python inference engine for Bayesian networks using inference by enumeration.
• Answers joint and conditional queries such as P(B=true, G=false | F=false) to 9 decimal places.
• Builds probability tables from training data, with normalization and epsilon smoothing for zero counts.

projects.title: Minimum Spanning Tree Algorithms on Road Networks
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive analysis and implementation of Prim's and Kruskal's MST algorithms with real-world road network datasets and performance benchmarking.
projects.fullDescription:
• Implemented and benchmarked Prim's and Kruskal's algorithms with Python and NetworkX.
• Tested on real road networks from 639 nodes (Maldives) to 898,430 nodes (Tokyo).
• Prim's won on dense graphs, Kruskal's on sparse ones; results plotted with Matplotlib.

projects.title: Red-Blue Nim Game with Minimax AI
projects.shortDescription: Interactive command-line game implementing Minimax algorithm with alpha-beta pruning for optimal strategy in two-pile marble game.
projects.fullDescription:
• Red-Blue Nim with a Minimax AI opponent and configurable search depth.
• Evaluation heuristic weighs red (2 pts) and blue (3 pts) marbles and prioritizes winning states.
• Command-line play with custom pile sizes, first player and difficulty.

projects.title: Aquarcade - Underwater Gaming Portal
projects.shortDescription: Responsive web application for underwater-themed arcade gaming zone with dark mode, multi-language support, and billing system.
projects.fullDescription:
• Subnautica-themed gaming portal built for IEEE & CSI SIES-GST Inspect Element 1.0.
• Game selection, time-slot booking, and automatic cost calculation with receipt generation.
• Dark mode and 3+ languages in vanilla JavaScript; responsive Bootstrap layout on GitHub Pages.

projects.title: Railway e-Ticketing Management System
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack web-based railway reservation system with real-time booking, cancellation, and status tracking capabilities.
projects.fullDescription:
• Railway reservation web app in PHP and MySQL.
• Seat allocation, waiting lists with auto-confirmation on cancellation, and PNR generation.
• Book up to 10 passengers, cancel, and check status from any browser; admin tools for schedules and seats.
